title: frametrail:attributes of type "chart"
description: Chart overlay: an animated bar, line or donut chart, or a progress ring, for numbers the video talks about. Overlay only. The values are lines of text ("Label: value") in data. This schema describes the frametrail:attributes of items whose type is "chart". On overlays, opacity, hoverStyle, zIndex and animation apply as on every overlay type. Unknown keys are allowed; writers keep them.

data.description: One "Label: value" per line ("=" works too); a line with only a number has an empty label. The ring uses the first value as a percentage. Grouping separators and a decimal comma are understood.

color.description: CSS colour of the bars, line or segments.

textColor.description: CSS colour of labels and values.

highlight.description: Index of the item drawn highlighted. -1 means none.

duration.description: Duration of the build-up in milliseconds, from the overlay's start.
